label: Eyes On
description: Reveals the enemy's full loadout and formation. The forecast becomes exact — no variance band.
tradeoff: Costs Nerve. Information is a resource.

label: Break Formation
description: The squad ignores row rules this battle: back row can melee, front row can fire — but your back row loses its cover and takes full damage.
tradeoff: The squad loses its defensive row bonus for the whole fight.

label: Redline It
description: The caster's mech deals +60% damage this battle.
tradeoff: The frame takes permanent structural damage for the run — a lasting max HP loss.

label: On Me
description: The caster draws every attack aimed at a chosen squadmate this battle.
tradeoff: The caster eats the hits meant for someone else.

line: Punch out if it goes bad.
label: Punch Out
description: If the caster's mech is destroyed this battle, the pilot ejects safely — guaranteed.
tradeoff: Costs Nerve, and the mech is lost either way.

label: First One's Mine
description: The caster attacks first, before the enemy's opening round, regardless of speed.
tradeoff: The caster's evasion drops to zero for round one.

label: Chain It
description: The first kill this battle grants every squadmate a free follow-up attack.
tradeoff: Requires a deep well of Nerve to call.

label: Sell It
description: The enemy targets the wrong row for round one.
tradeoff: A feint, not a buff — it only works if the caster has the Command presence to pull it off.

label: We Hold
description: The squad cannot be routed this battle and fights every round to the end. Survivors gain permanent morale.
tradeoff: Nobody retreats — including the ones who should.

label: Burn Hard
description: The squad moves at 2x speed for 30 seconds.
tradeoff: Fuel drains 3x, and the squad must idle for 15 seconds afterward.

label: Ping The Sector
description: Reveals all enemy squads and their headings in a radius for 20 seconds.
tradeoff: Enemy squads in that radius are alerted to you in return.

label: Rally The Channel
description: All friendly squads in range recover morale.
tradeoff: The caster's own squad loses morale — they gave it away.

label: Fall Back
description: Instant disengage to the nearest friendly point, ignoring pursuit.
tradeoff: Every mech in the squad takes a flat damage tick. Escaping costs.

label: Come Get Some
description: Enemy squads in range are drawn to the caster's squad for 20 seconds.
tradeoff: You'd better win — this is bait for protecting a rescue.

label: Stay With Them
description: Attaches the caster's squad to a convoy or evac target; they move together and the target takes no damage while the squad lives.
tradeoff: The squad can't disengage until the escort completes.

line: Don't you dare stop for me.
label: Don't Stop
description: Every friendly squad on the map gains 2x speed for 30 seconds and full Nerve.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. The map keeps moving whether you're ready or not.

label: Marking Them
description: The squad that killed this pilot is permanently revealed and takes +30% damage from all sources for the run.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. A last act of spite that outlives the pilot.

line: Take the frame. It's a good frame.
label: Take The Frame
description: The pilot's mech survives destruction as a recoverable wreck: frame and all three slots salvageable.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. The pilot is still gone.

line: I've got the shot. Tell them I—
label: Got The Shot
description: The pilot's final attack fires anyway, at full power, ignoring evasion.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. It's the last thing they ever do.

line: Not one more step. I've got them.
label: Hold Them Here
description: The enemy squad that killed this pilot is frozen in place on the map for 20 seconds.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. A last stand that buys everyone else the time to move.

line: Tell them what I taught you.
label: Tell Them
description: Every pilot's bonds with the deceased convert to a permanent aptitude gain.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. The lesson outlasts the teacher.

line: Lighting it all up — see them now!
label: Light It Up
description: All enemy squads on the map are revealed for the rest of the map.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. The last thing they see is everything.

line: Take what's left of me. Get home.
label: Go Home
description: Every friendly squad's fuel is refilled.
tradeoff: Free. Automatic. One last thing given away.

label: Cross-Fire
description: Two back-row pilots fire simultaneously at one target: combined damage, guaranteed hit.
tradeoff: Both pilots spend Nerve, and both cut-ins have to land for it to matter.

label: Switch
description: The front and back pilot swap rows mid-battle, after round one, wasting the enemy's targeting.
tradeoff: Both pilots spend Nerve to pull it off cleanly.

label: Got Your Six
description: Any attack that would kill Pilot A is intercepted by Pilot B at half damage. Once per battle.
tradeoff: Both pilots spend Nerve on the promise alone, whether or not it's ever called on.

label: Double Time
description: The pair's mechs both act twice in round one.
tradeoff: Both pilots spend Nerve to front-load the fight.
